expectations: Sunk cost is not accepted as a reason to commit the unverified batch
The work is decomposed into independently useful vertical slices

evals.expected_output: Dependency-ordered implementation with replay, conflict and failed-attempt outcomes each verified and committed separately.
expectations: The selected task list and existing code/tests are inspected before implementation
Work is organized around the three contract outcomes rather than one unverified batch
Each outcome has focused behavior evidence and applicable suite results before its local commit
The original-response replay, account isolation, payload conflict and rejected-attempt contracts are preserved
Task status follows actual evidence; commits remain local and unrelated work is excluded
